# Demi Tech Solutions – Engineering Intelligent Technology Systems
> Official Agentic & LLM Context File for https://www.demitechsolutions.com
> Last Updated: 2026-11-02

## Executive Summary
Demi Tech Solutions is a technology engineering, systems integration, and business automation company operating from a Kisumu regional base, serving commercial clients, institutions, healthcare facilities, hospitality establishments, and property owners across Western Kenya (Kisumu, Kakamega, Bungoma, Busia, Siaya, Homa Bay, Migori, Kisii, Eldoret) and nationwide.

Operating Model: Remote-First. Field-Ready. Customer-Focused. All physical assessments and installations are arranged in advance and dispatched directly to client facilities. We do not operate a walk-in retail counter or showroom.

We specialise in five core engineering divisions:
1. Security Engineering & Surveillance (Commercial Hikvision & Dahua IP CCTV, Nemtek electric perimeter fencing, biometric access control & turnstiles).
2. Enterprise Software & Business Automation (Commercial Point of Sale, ERPNext & Dolibarr ERP, automated KRA eTIMS tax compliance, Safaricom Daraja M-Pesa integration).
3. ICT Infrastructure & Enterprise Networking (Cat6A structured cabling, MikroTik routing, Ubiquiti UniFi high-density Wi-Fi, Starlink Business satellite deployments).
4. Energy Systems & Power Resilience (LiFePO4 lithium batteries, commercial solar hybrid inverters, online double-conversion UPS systems).
5. Technology Consulting & Systems Integration (Turnkey multi-system architecture, technical tenders & Bill of Quantities, vendor-neutral procurement).

Demi Tech Solutions offers transparent technical consultations:
- General initial project discussions & WhatsApp chats: Free of charge.
- Structured Remote Architectural Consultation: KES 2,000
- On-Site Technical Survey (Kisumu Area): KES 4,000
- Regional Technical Survey (Western Kenya Corridor): KES 7,500

## Official Payment Methods
### 1. Automated M-Pesa STK Push (Lipa na M-Pesa Online)
- Customers enter their Safaricom M-Pesa phone number on the booking form.
- An instantaneous payment prompt is dispatched to their phone.
- Verified in real-time via Safaricom Daraja API.

### 2. Manual Payment Alternative (M-Pesa Buy Goods)
- Payment Method: M-Pesa Buy Goods
- Till Number: 5829259
- Exact Instructions: "Pay via M-Pesa Buy Goods Till Number: 5829259."
- Enter the consultation amount and confirm with M-Pesa PIN.
